description: Rahmendaten zum AEP 2001, Wasserschutzgebiet (WSG) geplant is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Framework data for agricultural structural development planning for the Saarland (AEP) "Water protection areas (WSG) planned". Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Framework data for the AEP 2001, Water Protection Area (WSG) planned" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Saarland, Planungsunterlagen/ Kataster, AEP_Rahmendaten_WSG_Plan_region. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
